falsePositives.reason: visualqa §3: PageScript's li.line-clamp-2 ellipsis is intentional; any -webkit-line-clamp ancestor counts as an ellipsis.
visualqa §3 (P2-3): the floating 'Jump to latest' pill sits over the message list by design.
visualqa §3: the PageCard script view (PagesTab) is a scroller with a bottom mask fade by design.
BalloonLayer resolves a touch within 22 px (NEAREST_TAP_PX) to the nearest balloon through the art layer behind it, so probes landing on that layer still select the balloon.
The kit scenes' own scrolling <main> (qa/KitScenes.tsx, a harness wrapper, not product UI) has nothing focusable in the art scene; making it focusable would turn the whole page into a tap target.

knownFailures.reason: visualqa P0-3: on dense pages (3 long lines per panel) auto-placed balloons overlap each other and the stored edge balloons; needs render-time fit + the crowded chip.
StyleTab: a FAILED style option tile paints the 'Not drawn yet' placeholder on top of its own error text.
RecapCard / FormatPanel lettering option: 'Editable balloons' label spills out of its tile at 768 px.
ComicPageView: a FAILED page's error text is drawn over the plan sketch text on the Pages board (no backdrop / not laid out).
Page 9 of the 12-page fixture: auto-placed balloons in panels 4 and 5 overlap ~88 % on phone/tablet widths (render-time fit / placeBalloons).
LetteringToolbar 'Add a balloon' buttons are 30x28 and their ::after hit areas overlap, so each steals its neighbour's probes on touch.
LetteringToolbar SFX button: aria-label 'Add a sound effect' does not contain its visible text/title (label-content-name-mismatch).
Page editor (phone/tablet): the header (Close editor, Next page), the mode switch and the lettering toolbar sit inside the notch / status-bar inset — the dialog ignores --sa-top (mobile.md §5.6).
Page tools 'Panel to change' select is 28 px tall on touch.

axe target-size: the dictation settings caret is 21x44 with no spacing (same control as composer-dictation-split).
Composer option chips: aria-label ('Art style', 'Format: …', 'Quality and price per page') does not contain the visible chip text (label-content-name-mismatch).
The 'Stop' pill above the composer is 24 px tall and its ::after area runs under the composer surface.
Next-step chips: the aria-label ('Open the reader, free', 'Draw pages 3–5, about $0.18', …) does not contain the visible text (label-content-name-mismatch).
RecapCard 'Change the …' chips are 21 px tall; their ::after hit areas overlap the row above.
RendersCard progress bar has role=progressbar but no accessible name.
Dual-screen foldable: the page editor dialog spans both segments (the notes textarea and the lettering toolbar cross the fold); mobile.md §5.6 puts page and tools on separate segments.
Dual-screen foldable: centred sheets (Quality) open across the fold instead of on one segment (AdaptiveSheet).
While the comic loads, the studio renders no <main> landmark.
Comic settings → Confirm spending: the radio rows' buttons are 37 px tall inside their bordered rows.
The conversation/board resizer is a 30 px wide focusable strip that runs into the bottom safe-area band on tablets.
iPhone 15 (393x659 with browser UI): header + tab bar + chip rows leave the board panel / message list 36–42 % of the height (visualqa P1-6 floor is 45 %).
MobileTabBar: aria-label ('Board, 6 of 12 pages…') does not contain the visible tab text (label-content-name-mismatch).
Story / Style inline fields (title, genre, tone, audience, premise, setting, notes, themes, avoid chips and their 16 px remove buttons) are 16–40 px tall on touch.
CastTab character card: name/role inputs (29–33 px) and the 'Look details' disclosure (26 px) are below 44 px on touch.
PagesTab page card: the 14 px select checkbox, 'Show the script' and the script scroller are below 44 px on touch.
ReaderTab toolbar (Print / PDF / PNG / Motion) buttons are 36x40 and clipped 8–21 px by the panel at iPhone heights (the ReaderTab min-h fix).
StyleTab: a failed style option's 'Retry' label is clipped by its tile.
PagesTab: the 'Open page n in the editor' button contains focusable controls (nested-interactive) and its aria-label drops the visible text (label-content-name-mismatch).
StyleTab option tile: 'Check again' (15 px tall) and 'Use …' (43x40) sit on the tile edge, so probes leave the button.
CastTab: on a failed sheet the 'model sheet keeps them on-model' hint overlaps the Retry button (iPad Pro portrait).
PublicComicReader header ignores --sa-top: 'Close reader' sits inside the status-bar / notch inset.
ComicReaderView toolbar ('Full screen', 'Scroll'/'Page' mode) clipped and inside the top inset at iPhone heights.
BookTimeline dock buttons ('Book', 'Open Media') sit inside the bottom home-indicator inset on tablets (no --sa-bottom padding).
TimelineClip role=option tiles contain focusable controls (nested-interactive) and their aria-label ('Page 2, ready') drops the visible text (label-content-name-mismatch).
TimelineClip 'failed' badge: white 8.5 px text on red-600/90 measures 4.35:1 (needs 4.5:1).
BreakdownCard inline links ('About $x to draw. Show the cost breakdown', 'Add a photo (free)') are 16–18 px tall; their hit areas overlap the text and chip rows around them.
RefTile: the 'Main' badge (top-left) overlaps the label chip ('Face close-up') on the first photo of the drawer grid at 768–1440 px.
ImmersiveReader scroll mode: the book-stage scroller has no keyboard access (scrollable-region-focusable).
The theme-invariant accent #D97757 gives ~3.1:1 against white text and against the light canvas; small accent text and white-on-accent labels need 4.5:1 (a darker text accent, or large/bold only).
--ds-muted on the soft surfaces measures 4.36:1 for 11–12 px text (needs 4.5:1).

BreakdownCard page/cover tiles: the aria-label ('Page 2, 4 panels, not drawn, about $0.07 to draw') does not contain the tile's visible text (label-content-name-mismatch, WCAG 2.5.3) — start the label with the visible words.
RefTile (role=button): the aria-label ('Photo 2, Side') does not contain the tile's visible text (label chip / badges) — label-content-name-mismatch, WCAG 2.5.3.

EasyLetteringPanel on touch: Smaller/Bigger text (32 px), the text-colour swatches (28 px, their 44 px ::after areas overlap each other), the font chips (23 px tall, rows touching) and 'More…' (55x25) are below 44 px / steal each other's probes.

Phone landscape (734x343): the editor page is ~104 px wide, so the selected balloon's tail and width handles' 44 px hit areas overlap each other and the page edge (mobile.md §5.6 landscape editor layout).
Phone landscape: the editor's lettering panel (Balloon type: Shout, Robot / radio …) runs into the right notch inset — the editor ignores --sa-left/--sa-right.

StyleTab palette swatches: the 16 px 'Remove #hex' buttons are opacity-0 until hover (group-hover), so on touch they are invisible yet tappable (StyleTab.tsx; the CastTab ref-remove button uses the same pattern).
ComicReaderView: the side 'Previous page' / 'Next page' zones (md+) are opacity-0 until hover, so on touch tablets they are invisible yet tappable.

knownTestFailures.reason: PageEditor does not mount TouchCanvas yet (mobile.md §5.1), so a pinch never zooms the page (data-zoom stays 1).
BalloonLayer commits a balloon drag even when a second finger lands mid-drag; mobile.md §5.4 requires a cancel with no op (GestureArbiter integration).

knownTestFailures.test: public\.reader\.spec\.ts › .*header respects the top safe area
knownTestFailures.reason: PublicComicReader's header ignores --sa-top, so its controls start inside the status-bar / notch inset.

knownTestFailures.test: studio\.back\.spec\.ts › Back closes the top layer ›
knownTestFailures.reason: Phone landscape (343 px tall): BoardPane's full 'Waiting for your approval' gate banner covers the Pages grid, so 'Open page 1 in the editor' cannot be tapped (Playwright: the banner intercepts the pointer).

knownTestFailures.test: editor\.touch\.spec\.ts › .*drag distance maps to page fractions
knownTestFailures.reason: Phone landscape (734x343): the editor renders the page only 104 px wide (balloons 39x6 px), so dragging a selected balloon grabs its tail handle and moves the tail, not the balloon (mobile.md §5.6 landscape editor layout).

knownTestFailures.test: reader\.formfactor\.spec\.ts › .*default layout and the page fits the viewport
knownTestFailures.reason: Phone landscape: the reader leaves ~24 px gutters (page 568 px in a 616 px stage); mobile.md §7.1 asks for fit:width (page = stage width ± 2 px).
Phone landscape with the keyboard up (visual viewport 143 px): the composer textarea and Send stay below the keyboard (bottom 186/232 px).
PagesTab thumbnails load the 1536 px originals instead of the 480w variants (urlFor(asset, {width}) / srcSet not wired; P2-BOARD 'PagesTab … 480w').

knownTestFailures.test: editor\.touch\.spec\.ts › .*after a 2× pinch a 60 px drag
knownTestFailures.reason: PageEditor does not mount TouchCanvas yet, so there is no pinch zoom to drag at (mobile.md §5.1/§10.4: at 2× a 60 px drag must move the balloon 30 px of page).

knownTestFailures.test: reader\.formfactor\.spec\.ts › .*a hidden HUD takes no taps
knownTestFailures.reason: ReaderHud hides its rows with opacity-0 + pointer-events-none, but the bars inside keep pointer-events-auto, so Close reader / Guided View / Reader settings / Full screen stay tappable while invisible (a tap meant to bring the HUD back can close the reader). Fix: pointer-events-none on the bars too (or inert) while hidden.

pixel-8 at CPU 4×: the frames while a balloon moves stay at 50–75 ms, but releasing it (the balloon op → re-render of the editor and board) is one 190–230 ms task; mobile.md §10.4 allows no long task > 100 ms during the drag (memoise the page/board under the editor, or commit in a transition).
